[SWS_LinIf_00674] ⌈After reception of each frame of a TP message (SF, FF and
CF), the LIN Interface shall call the function PduR_LinTpCopyRxData with an info
pointer containing received data (SduDataPtr) and data length (SduLength). The
data length is 5 bytes (including SID) for FF, up to 6 bytes for SF and 6 bytes for CF (or
less in case of the last CF).⌋
The output pointer parameter provides the LIN Interface with available receive buffer
size after data have been copied.
